description: This file implements a React functional component for a login page with a two-step authentication flow. It manages email input, organization retrieval, manual org ID input, password input, and handles login logic with navigation upon success or error handling.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles fetching user organizations based on the entered email and transitions to credentials step.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Performs login with provided email, organization, and password, manages redirection or error handling.
